text:
Predicates:
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
BornInCity(x, y) ::: x is born in city y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
WriteBook(x, y) ::: x wrote book y.
NovelWriter(x) ::: x is a novel writer.
CreatedPodcast(x, y) ::: x created podcast y.
Premises:
¬Podcast(x) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornInCity(x, americanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀y ∃x (Novel(y) ∧ WriteBook(x, y) → NovelWriter(x)) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WriteBook(daniShapiro, familyHistory) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(familyHistory) ∧ WrittenInYear(familyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
CreatedPodcast(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
BornInCity(boston, americanCity) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
¬Novel(familySecrets) ::: Family Secrets is not a novel.
